c74object.name: openscofo~
c74object.digest: Real-time score-following system designed for contemporary music.

description.p: openscofo~ follows an OpenScofo score from an incoming audio signal, reports the current score event and tempo, schedules score actions, and can output requested audio descriptors.

metadatalist.metadata: © 2003 - 2021 ICST | Zurich University of the Arts

description.p: Loads an OpenScofo score file. If the supplied symbol has no file extension, .scofo is appended before the file is searched for in Max's file path. On success, the current event is reset to 0, the current tempo and event are output, and the score's FFT and hop sizes are applied.
Clears pending actions, resets the current score event to 0, outputs the current tempo and event, and enables following. A score must be loaded first.
Use follow 1 to enable following and follow 0 to disable following. A score must be loaded before changing the follow state.

Sets runtime options. set event index sets the current score event. set onnxmodel path descriptors... loads an ONNX model and declares the descriptor order used when training it. set verbosity level sets console logging, where 0 is warnings, 1 is info, 2 is debug, and 3 is trace. set description 1 or set justdescription 1 enables description-only mode; use 0 to disable it.

Reads one FFT-size frame from a buffer~, computes the requested descriptors, and outputs them from the descriptor outlet. An optional start sample index can be supplied: get description buffername start.
